note: GD-06, seal immutability. This file is the record of what is under data/sealed/. The guard recomputes the record from the directory and fails if the two disagree in either direction: a file that is not listed, a listed file that is gone, or a listed file whose bytes changed. Phase 02 sealed nothing by pulling; the one entry is a quarantine. Game 823543 was scheduled on an open day and its officialDate landed inside the sealed window, so the staging puller's copy was moved under the seal unread and is recorded here by digest. frozen_at is that quarantine, not the seal event: docs/prereg/SEAL.md records the seal event in prose when it happens.

quarantine.reason: schedule date 2026-09-21 but officialDate in the sealed window; pulled by the pre-fleet staging puller

constants_source: config/seal.yml, which mirrors SOP section 2.4. UT-17 asserts it agrees with quality/sql/analysis_set.sql. All six constants here equal the lines of that file.
partition_note: The partition reads officialDate, never gameDate. Game 825030 is a 2026-09-15 game whose gameDate is 2026-09-16T01:40:00Z.
regular_tail_rule: Season 2026, gameType R, officialDate on or after seal_start_date. quality/sql/analysis_set.sql is the rule. This list is its output on the source below, one entry per gamePk.

regular_gamepks_source.query: schedule, sportId 1, season 2026, gameType R, hydrate officials
regular_gamepks_source.note: 90 rows, 88 gamePks. Two postponed placeholders repeat an id: 823543 and 824785. The 88 are 15 on 2026-09-22, 16 on 09-23, 12 on 09-24 and 15 on each of 09-25, 09-26 and 09-27, by officialDate at the file time. A gamePk keeps its id when a game moves, so a postponement does not change this list. A game that moves past regular_season_end stays in it. A new gamePk issued after the file time is held out by the rule and is absent here.

gamepks_sha256_rule: sha256 of regular_gamepks plus postseason_gamepks when present, as decimal ids sorted ascending, one per line, each line ending in a newline.
postseason_note: Not written at M1. Before the unseal, one commit tagged seal-postseason adds postseason_gamepks and postseason_appended_at and recomputes gamepks_sha256. It changes no other key.
